facts.text: Andrew named his pet Buddy because he considers him a buddy and hopes Buddy will become friends with Toby.

evidence.quote: I named him Buddy because he's my buddy and I hope him and Toby become buddies!

facts.text: Andrew and Buddy enjoy going on walks together as a way to spend time and get fresh air.

evidence.quote: Buddy and I have a great time doing walks. It's a nice way to spend time together and get some fresh air.

facts.text: Andrew and Buddy also enjoy hiking and exploring new trails, which Buddy seems to enjoy and show interest in.

evidence.quote: He loves checking out new hiking trails with us. It's awesome to see him so stoked and interested in everything nature has to offer.
